text.description_html:
Acorn AIXBQ, 6" Bean Tip Cabinet Strap Smooth Iron Hinge

The 6" Smooth Iron Strap Hinge is suitable for light weight doors or cabinets. Its old world charm is in both the bean tip design and in the smooth iron finish which is typical of early American styling, with a flat black appearance which simulates the hardware as it may have looked originally if it was forged a century ago. The Smooth Iron Cabinet Bean Tip Strap Hinge has a lifetime no rust warranty. Click Here to see the entire Acorn Bean Tip Collection

Also Available: 6 Inch Offset Smooth Iron Cabinet Bean Tip Strap Hinge and Acorn RIXBQ 6" Rough Iron Cabinet Strap Hinges

Features for the Acorn Bean Tip Cabinet Strap Hinge:

  • For doors whose face sits flush with the door frame.
  • For exterior and interior use.
  • Packaged with black finish mounting screws.
  • Lifetime No-Rust Warranty

Specifications of the Flush Bean Tip Cabinet Strap Hinge:

  • Finish: Smooth Black Iron
  • Material: Iron
  • Length: 6"
  • Width: 1-3/4"

Sold as a pair (2-hinges).
